title: Code and supporting data for Cross-connectome transfer of a Drosophila spiking feeding model: proofreading stability, reconstruction shifts, and homolog calibration
description: MIT-licensed simulation and analysis code, S2A/V7.1 programmatic verification script, standalone MaleCNS input manifest, archived Chinese protocol, nine archived result files, and nine supplementary files for the V7.1 submission (v5.0, v6.0, and v7.0 retained for provenance).
